title: A Regiment for the Uniform
author: Emrys Kavanagh
blurb: Hazel Eriksen, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
